questions.subject: Civil Engineering
questions.questionMarkup: Which of the following is incorrect in context of a bar-chart’s use in projects?
questions.questionText: Which of the following is incorrect in context of a bar-chart’s use in projects?

options.html: It can only be used for small and simple projects and for projects that are repetitive in nature.
options.text: It can only be used for small and simple projects and for projects that are repetitive in nature.

options.html: In bar chart, sub-activities of an activity can be represented but they lack in degree of detail.
options.text: In bar chart, sub-activities of an activity can be represented but they lack in degree of detail.

options.html: Interdependencies between the activities can not be depicted in bar chart.
options.text: Interdependencies between the activities can not be depicted in bar chart.

options.html: Critical and non-critical activities are not separated while using bar chart.
options.text: Critical and non-critical activities are not separated while using bar chart.

questions.explanationHtml:
(b)
A bar chart has following deficiencies:
• It can only be used for small and simple projects.
• It is used only for projects that are repetitive in nature.
• As bar chart lacks in showing project progress. It makes controlling of project with bar chart
difficult.
• In bar chart, sub-activities of an activity can not be represented, so bar chart lacks in degree of
details.
• Interdependencies between the activities can not be depicted in bar chart.
• Critical and non-critical activities are not separated in bar chart.
